rules.statement: A co-owner cannot get a possessory decree against another co-owner in respect of a divided portion of the common land.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is settled law that every co-owner has a right to possess and enjoy the whole property and every part of it, and it is not open to a co-owner, which the plaintiff is, to prevent another co-owner such as the defendant possessing and enjoying a part of that property."
